title: Intake interview: Office Manager
source_system: Interview (Office Manager)
what_it_shows: Accounts are added and removed when remembered, on verbal requests with no checklist, and are never reviewed; the MSP changes firewall and suite settings without written approval; returns and source documents are emailed to clients as attachments when they ask; client information is held in the tax software, the portal, suite mailboxes and folders, the payroll and accounting platforms, practice management, the desktops through sync, and the MFP drive; one misdirected email with a client's return in 2025 was handled informally with no record; 2 desktops replaced in 2024 have no disposal record; MSP technicians have never been given a written IRC 6713 and 7216 notice

source_system: Interview (Owner CPA)

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (Owner CPA, Bookkeeper, Client Services Coordinator, Office Manager, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, vendors and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say it can tolerate. The Owner CPA describes the April 15 and October 15 deadlines and extensions as the fallback; the Bookkeeper says most pay dates fall on Fridays and the payroll data is held by the payroll platform, with input worksheets in the suite; the Client Services Coordinator says scans wait on the MFP or the reception desktop until they sync

title: Risk assessment interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees and the MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past events and near misses. No call-back verification is used when a client asks by email or portal message to change a refund direct deposit account, or when someone asks the Bookkeeper to change a payroll employee's bank account; preparers usually compare bank details with the prior-year return, and the Bookkeeper knows most client contacts by voice; returns filed per EFIN and PTIN are not checked weekly, and PTIN holders look at their own annual counts; drafts from the AI assistant have no review checklist and a CPA or enrolled agent signs each letter; the Owner CPA's phone hotspot is the only internet fallback; the MSP lead technician states the MSP holds the backup console and firewall management logins and that its remote management console requires MFA, with no supporting evidence supplied

title: Account comparison, 2026-07-08
source_system: Payroll terminations (EV-001) compared with tax software and suite user lists; tax software and suite sign-in logs
what_it_shows: The seasonal assistant, whose last day was 2026-04-17, still had active tax software and suite accounts about 12 weeks later; sign-in logs show no use after 2026-04-17; both accounts were disabled on 2026-07-08; the portal and payroll platform were not part of the comparison

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees and the MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each Safeguards Rule element and IRC 7216 duty is carried out today. The Owner CPA (2026-07-06) states the 2024 WISP was never revisited and that the Owner CPA did not know of the next-business-day IRS report in Pub. 1345; staff (2026-07-07) state the WISP was never shared with them and nobody knew of the FTC notice rule; nobody reviews logs; no retention rule, control testing, vulnerability scan or penetration test exists; nobody has checked the Office Manager's or the MSP's security knowledge; vendors were chosen on price and features with no security check or later review; the Bookkeeper uses return information only for the same client's books and payroll; the firm uses no staff or contractors outside the United States; MSP technicians can reach client files on every computer and lessor technicians service the MFP; new applications were adopted with no security evaluation

source_system: Interviews (Owner CPA, Senior Tax Accountant, Tax Accountant, Tax Preparer)

source_system: Tax software, suite, portal, payroll platform and AI assistant user lists compared with the staff roster; seasonal assistant termination record; Office Manager interview
what_it_shows: Account types, approvals and procedures are not documented and accounts are not reviewed or monitored; account managers are named (the MSP for the suite on the Office Manager's request, the Senior Tax Accountant for the tax software, the Client Services Coordinator for the portal); the staff roster lists every authorized user; tax software roles match job duties for all 7 employees; the seasonal assistant's portal staff account was still active on 2026-08-04 and was removed that day, with no portal sign-in after 2026-04-17; a shared "scanner" mailbox exists and its password has not changed since the MFP was installed

title: Control assessment: personnel termination review
source_system: Seasonal assistant termination record; suite MFA registrations; Office Manager interview
what_it_shows: No time limit is set for disabling access; the seasonal assistant's accounts were disabled about 12 weeks after the last day; the assistant's MFA registration and phone mail profile were not revoked; no exit discussion of confidentiality or IRC 7216 duties; office key and badge returned on the last day; the assistant's work files remain in the client folders

title: Control assessment: least privilege review
source_system: Suite administrator role report; suite sharing report; MSP endpoint policy
what_it_shows: The Owner CPA and the Office Manager use global administrator rights on their everyday email accounts; every employee can open every client folder, including payroll files

title: Control assessment: administrator MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Suite and tax software administrator MFA settings; sign-in tests on the backup console and firewall management login with the MSP lead technician present
what_it_shows: MFA enforced for suite and tax software administrator accounts; the backup console and the firewall management login accepted a password alone in testing on 2026-08-04

title: Control assessment: user MFA and legacy authentication test
source_system: Suite authentication settings; legacy authentication sign-in report; MFP scan-to-email configuration; test sign-in

title: Control assessment: training records and staff interviews
source_system: 2024 video sign-in sheet; 2024 WISP; interviews with all 7 employees
what_it_shows: Training was a single 2024 video; the seasonal assistant was never trained; no phishing exercises, reminders or content updates

title: Control assessment: log review interview
source_system: Suite alert settings; tax software audit report; Office Manager interview
what_it_shows: Audit records are not reviewed; suite alerts are not configured; nobody is named to receive review results

title: Control assessment: incident reporting interviews
source_system: Interviews with all 7 employees; draft POL-03; the 2025 misdirected email
what_it_shows: No reporting time was set at fieldwork and POL-03 was a draft; 5 of 7 staff did not know whom to call about an unexpected MFA prompt; reporting to the IRS Stakeholder Liaison, the FTC and the states was not defined, and the Owner CPA was unaware of the next-business-day rule; the 2025 misdirected email has no record

title: Control assessment: backup configuration review
source_system: SYS-08 job report (July 2026) and retention settings from the MSP; backup console sign-in test; tax software vendor SOC 2 report
what_it_shows: Mailboxes and client folders backed up daily to SYS-08 (July 2026 job report); suite tenant settings and the firewall configuration are not backed up on a schedule; the policy and SSP drafts are stored in suite folders covered by the daily backup; the backup vendor encrypts stored copies; the immutable retention setting was not shown; the shared MSP administrator account without MFA can delete backup copies; no full restore has ever been performed

title: Control assessment: contingency test review
source_system: MSP restore tickets; MSP lead technician interview
what_it_shows: No contingency plan exists and no restore or plan test has ever been performed; the MSP confirmed that no full restore test record exists

title: Control assessment: risk assessment documents
source_system: P01 risk register and report; 2024 WISP; Owner CPA review of 2026-07-24; Owner CPA interview
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment was completed 2026-07-17 with SP 800-30 Tables G-5 and I-2, covers threats and vulnerabilities for every system and harm to clients, and uses the BIA impact categories; the Owner CPA reviewed the draft register on 2026-07-24; it was shared with the Owner CPA, the Office Manager and the MSP lead technician; no update cycle has operated, the 2024 WISP was never revisited, and the March 2026 AI adoption prompted no reassessment

title: Control assessment: provider agreement review
source_system: MSP contract; SaaS terms; AI assistant business terms; tax software vendor SOC 2 report; MSP questionnaire request of 2026-07-27
what_it_shows: The MSP contract has no security requirements, IRC 7216 terms or written notice, and defines the MSP's duties; the AI assistant was adopted with no review and its terms allow processing outside the United States; no ongoing monitoring of providers; the MSP questionnaire and evidence request sent on 2026-07-27 was not returned by 2026-08-05, and the technician list, MFA evidence for the remote management platform and the backup subcontractor's terms were not received

title: Control assessment: email transmission test
source_system: Sample of 15 emails with returns sent in the 2026 season; portal settings; suite encryption options
what_it_shows: 6 of 15 sampled emails sent returns as plain attachments; no rule blocks SSNs in outbound attachments

title: Control assessment: encryption review and test
source_system: MSP encryption report; encryption status checked on 2 desktops and 1 laptop; MFP storage settings
what_it_shows: The 4 desktops, which sync all client folders, are unencrypted (2 checked); the laptop checked is encrypted; the MFP keeps scanned images on its drive

title: Control assessment: access agreement review
source_system: Employee confidentiality agreements; seasonal assistant onboarding file; MSP contract
